description: A model of any monadic sentence, in any Lean universe, yields an explicit labelled table model of some size between \(1\) and \(B(\varphi)\), accepted by the shared finite evaluator.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.bounded_table_model.{u_1} {k : ℕ} {M : Type u_1}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure M] [Nonempty M]
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Sentence) (hφ : M ⊨ φ) :
  ∃ d < Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.bound φ,
    ∃ T,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.evaluate 0
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.arities k) T φ Fin.elim0 =
        true
